name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SEO Manager | Technical SEO, AEO/GEO Strategy & Team Leadership
summary: Marketing operations leader with 4+ years of direct SEO work inside a 15+ year B2B career, spanning national agency SEO (Level Agency), technical SEO audits and schema implementation for a multi-client book (Solenzo), and 2 years managing a team of onboarding specialists (Wix, 20 then 8 people). Builds and runs AI agent systems daily, including hands-on use of Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, and Google AI Studio, and treats AI-search visibility as a natural extension of the technical SEO work already underway rather than a separate discipline. Root-causes performance claims instead of trusting a dashboard number, and briefs client-facing owners on the strategy and evidence behind every recommendation.

experience.title: SEO Strategy Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own SEO strategy and delivery for a portfolio of B2B service clients, running technical SEO audits, keyword gap analysis, and competitor research in Screaming Frog, then implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Identify and implement schema and structured data as part of every technical SEO audit, pulling full on-page schema implementation ahead of remediation.

Root-caused a stacked two-bug conversion-tracking failure for a client (a form-relay redirect race condition and a sandboxed iframe isolating the GTM dataLayer) that had silently prevented its highest-value lead conversion from ever firing; verified the fix end to end via direct browser inspection rather than platform debug tooling.

Claim, set up, and optimize Google Business Profile listings as the first deliverable in every client engagement, the foundation the rest of each client's local-search and lead-flow program builds on.

Build and deploy AI agent systems for clients using Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, and Google AI Studio, translating non-technical stakeholders' intent into structured prompts and reliable automation; built rubric-based grading criteria to score AI-generated output against defined standards.

Report SEO and marketing performance to business-owner stakeholders on a regular cadence, tracking GA4 and Google Search Console across concurrent accounts to turn findings into a prioritized action plan rather than a status update.

experience.title: SEO & Content Strategist — Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Directed SEO and content direction for a book of national B2B clients, running keyword research and search-term analysis to shape organic content strategy and campaign targeting.
Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and organic conversion KPIs, translating results into optimization recommendations and QBRs for client leadership.
Coordinated execution across internal departments as strategic lead on multi-stakeholder accounts, holding delivery quality consistent across implementations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail), retaining all but one (~94% retention), on Birdeye's proprietary local-listings/data-aggregator solution.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value and reduce onboarding friction.

experience.title: People Manager — Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, coaching individual performance and owning delivery quality across a high-value account portfolio.

Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices, including client Google Business Profile setup, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new hires and developed sales training for tenured account executives as a new Wix vertical scaled from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
